svg.title: Rev D panel and DOL starter connection overview
svg.desc: Conceptual mechanical overview with verified panel connector signals. Main board retains guarded mains circuitry. Separate panel uses isolated 3.3 and 5 volt circuits. Local and external STOP contacts are series connected.
svg.text: A separate control panel, one low-voltage cable
Rev D • 1 HP single-phase pump controller • Connection overview, not an installation or enclosure-fit approval
Main PCB 90 × 70 mm • guarded power section
Motor power and capacitor-start wiring stay in the starter.
Main-board and original meter terminals need insulating covers.
60 × 45 mm • only isolated 3.3 V / 5 V circuits
Push-caps, OLED mounting and connector clearance require fit checks.
Either STOP opens the hardware permission path
The external link substitutes only for an unused external STOP.
JP1 link only if J3 is unused
Reuse or add external momentary buttons
J2 START, J4 MODE, J5 SET and J6 NEXT use NO contacts
in parallel with the corresponding local button.
Mode request only; it cannot bypass STOP or other protection.
Existing starter buttons: separate isolated auxiliary contacts only.
One conductor per listed signal; common ground uses J32.7.
J33.2 is the same main-board GND: leave its wire cavity empty
in this fanout. No double-crimped ground terminal is required.
J7 OLED order: 1 SCL • 2 SDA • 3 GND • 4 +3V3
Conceptual component placement and wiring paths • Not to scale • Wire identities must be verified on the actual starter before installation
